name: example-impeccable-insight-dashboard
title: Product Insight Dashboard
description: Light editorial product-analytics dashboard: warm paper neutrals, Fraunces serif display voice, one deep-teal accent, hairline-separated KPI band, hand-drawn SVG trend chart with prior-period comparison, channel table with share bars, and a written insights rail. Use when the brief mentions "analytics dashboard", "KPI report", "product metrics", "executive readout". Original page following the published design rules of pbakaus/impeccable.

query.en: Build a light, editorial product-analytics dashboard — KPI band, weekly-active-users trend chart with a prior-period comparison, signups-by-channel table, and a written insights column.
